name: Lodha Developers
why: Profit breakout: +103% YoY and above the last 4 quarters
Management outlook: Our commitment of 20% PAT growth is an annual guidance, not a quarterly one.
Latest quarter Jun 2026: Excellent (sales +43% YoY, profit +103% YoY)
FIIs (foreign funds) raised holding by 1.2 pts in a year
Cost quality excellent: costs falling, margin expanding, operating profit growing (costs 72% to 62% of sales)
risks: Working capital stretching - debtor days 21 to 32, inventory days n/a (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
Sector cycle: Weak / out of favour

guidance: Our commitment of 20% PAT growth is an annual guidance, not a quarterly one.
Thus, overall, we expect land to be between INR 2,000 crores to INR 3,000 crores of sales every year for the next several years.
capex: Our capital allocation hierarchy is clear and publicly stated, fund opportunities where there is brand fit and execution capacity, about 20% ROCE in DevCo and about 15% in RentCo, a regular dividend at 15% to 20% of PAT,
My first question is whenever you sell a land, say, 1-acre land to a data center client, so how much capex do you need to incur on that on a cash flow basis?
risks: Uncertainty abroad is and will cause NRIs to want to secure a home base in India.
Where this leaves us is that a prolonged conflict increases uncertainty, and I will not pretend otherwise.
focus: We have one more launch coming up in Bangalore, 2 in Pune, and we'll also be entering the NCR and 2 launch in MMR.
One of the biggest strengths of ours, which is less understood is our ability to innovate and being the first to bring in new products in the market.
We are similarly also innovating new product categories within our existing projects.
